description: arXiv:2609.36047v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain...
author: Alexis de Villeroch\'e, Beniamin Bogosel, St\'ephane Breuils, Dorin Bucur, Jacques-Olivier Lachaud
